description: This file defines a class 'Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_Block_Plugin' that handles compilation of Smarty template block plugins in PHP. It contains methods for compiling, setting up callbacks and attributes for block plugins, and managing nested plugin tags during template compilation.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_Block_Plugin
classes.description: Handles compilation of block plugin code in Smarty templates, managing attributes, nesting, and callback execution during template compilation.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles PHP code for executing a Smarty block plugin, handling opening and closing tags, callbacks, and template caching logic.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares callback functions and parameter arrays for the block plugin based on parsed template attributes.
